movelist.name: Spikes
movelist.effect: Set 8 square meters of Spikes within your range, all 8 meters must be adjacent with at least one other space of Spikes. Spikes cause terrain to count as Slow Terrain, and a grounded foe that runs into the hazards will lose a Tick of Hit Points and become Slowed until the end of their next turn.

movelist.name: Smokescreen
movelist.effect: Smokescreen creates a blast of Smoke that covers the target area; the Smoke persists until the end of the encounter, or until Defog or Whirlwind are used. All targets attacking from or into the Smoke receive a -3 penalty to Accuracy.

movelist.name: Water Pulse
movelist.effect: Water Pulse Confuses the target on 17+.

abilities.name: Mud Dweller
abilities.effect: The user resists Ground-Type and Water-Type attacks one step further.

abilities.name: Protean
abilities.effect: The user’s Type changes to match the Type of the triggering Move. This Ability resolves before the Move is resolved (And thus you may apply STAB, and trigger other Features and Abilities appropriately).

abilities.name: Wash Away
abilities.trigger: The user hits with a Water Type Move
abilities.effect: Before the Move “hits”, all Combat Stages on targets hit by the Move are reset to their default (usually 0), and all coats on the targets, except ones placed by Water Sport, are destroyed.
